docs.title: Wolds Record user knowledge base
docs.text:
Welcome to the Wolds Record knowledge base for organisations and day-to-day users.

Wolds Record is owned and operated by Wolds Canine Ltd.

  • Knowledge base home
  • Marketing website: https://www.woldsrecord.com/
  • App: https://app.woldsrecord.com/dashboard
  • Support: support@woldsrecord.com

Use these guides to complete your main workflows:

  • Create your account and sign in
  • Set up your organisation and user profile
  • Create clients, dogs, and cases
  • Record treatment sessions
  • Generate and share vet reports
  • Maintain organisation settings and export your data

docs.title: Quick start path
docs.text:
If you are new, follow this order:

  1. Sign in and create your account
  2. Create or join your organisation
  3. Set up your user profile
  4. Create your first client and dog
  5. Open a case and log your first session

Continue to the Getting started section from the left-hand navigation.

docs.title: Create your organisation
docs.text:
After first sign-in, if no active organisation exists, you are directed to onboarding.

  1. Enter your organisation details.
  2. Submit the onboarding form.
  3. You are added as the initial organisation member.
  4. The new organisation becomes your active organisation.

docs.title: Switch active organisation
docs.text:
If you are a member of multiple organisations, use the organisation switcher to make one organisation active.

Your active organisation controls which clients, dogs, cases, sessions, and settings you can access.

docs.title: Access and permissions
docs.text: If you try to open an organisation where you are not a member, access is blocked and you are redirected.

docs.title: Create an account
docs.text:
1. Open the sign-in screen.
  2. Leave the mode set to Create your account.
  3. Enter your Email address and Password.
  4. Select Create account.
  5. Complete the bot protection check if prompted.
  6. Open the verification email and confirm the account before signing in.

docs.title: Sign in with an existing account
docs.text:
1. On the sign-in screen, select Use existing account.
  2. Enter your email and password.
  3. Complete the bot protection check if prompted.
  4. Select Sign in.

After success, you are redirected to your dashboard.

docs.title: Sign out
docs.text: Use Sign Out in the top navigation. This ends your current session and returns you to the sign-in page.

docs.title: Common issues
docs.text:
• Invalid login credentials: re-check email/password and try again.
  • No confirmation email: check junk/spam and retry sign-up.
  • Email not verified: open the latest verification email, complete confirmation, then sign in again.
  • Session lost: sign in again from /sign-in.

docs.title: Product Overview
docs.text:
Wolds Record, owned by Wolds Canine Ltd, supports canine rehabilitation practitioners with structured, searchable case records.

This section will grow to include end-user workflows and screen-level guidance.

docs.title: Create and manage clients and dogs
Create a client
docs.text:
From Clients:

  1. Select New client.
  2. Enter:
  3. Client name (required)
  4. Email (optional)
  5. Phone (optional)
  6. Address (optional)
  7. Select Create client.

docs.title: Add a dog to a client
docs.text:
From the client record:

  1. Select Add dog.
  2. Enter required dog information:
  3. Dog name
  4. Sex
  5. Date of birth or approximate age
  6. Ownership duration
  7. Neutered status
  8. Optionally set breed and vet practice.
  9. Select Create dog.

docs.title: Vet practice assignment during dog setup
docs.text:
When adding a dog, you can:

  • Select an existing vet practice, or
  • Create a new practice inline and assign it immediately.

docs.title: "No active organisation"
docs.text: Your account is not currently set to an active organisation. Re-run onboarding or switch organisation.

docs.title: "Access denied" / redirected to unauthorized
docs.text: Your user is not a member of that organisation or does not have access to that route.

docs.title: "Missing ... details"
docs.text: A required route parameter or record context was not found (for example client, dog, case, or session id).

docs.title: Save failures
docs.text:
When a save fails:

  1. Check required fields first.
  2. Retry after confirming your session is still active.
  3. If still failing, capture the on-screen error and email support at support@woldsrecord.com.

docs.title: Create a case
docs.text:
From a dog record:

  1. Select Create case.
  2. The app creates a minimal open case and takes you straight to the case edit screen.
  3. Complete or update the intake fields, then save the case.

The edit flow includes core presenting complaint and history/lifestyle context so each case can be completed with structured baseline data.

docs.title: Edit case details
docs.text: Open a case and select Edit to update status, notes, and other intake values as treatment progresses.

docs.title: Case-level navigation
docs.text:
Each case acts as the parent record for sessions and vet reports. Use the case page to:

  • Review current case context
  • Start a new session
  • Open past session entries

docs.title: Dashboard and search
docs.text:
The dashboard and top navigation provide two key tools:

  1. Global search in the top navigation
  2. Recent sessions overview

docs.title: Search clients and dogs
docs.text:
Use the search control in the top navigation from any signed-in page.

  1. Enter at least 2 characters in the search box.
  2. Review matching clients and dogs.
  3. Select a result to jump directly to that record.

If many results exist, refine your query for a narrower list.

docs.title: Review recent sessions
docs.text:
Use the recent sessions table to quickly navigate to:

  • Client record
  • Dog record
  • Session detail

This is helpful for daily follow-ups and continuity of care.

docs.title: Manage your user profile
docs.text: Use Profile to keep your practitioner profile details current.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: • Full name (required)

docs.title: Update profile
docs.text:
1. Open Profile.
  2. Edit your full name.
  3. Select Save profile.

If successful, you will see Profile updated.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text: • Keep your full name accurate for reports and team visibility.

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: Enable a new practitioner to sign in, create their organisation, and begin recording cases safely.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Sign in using the shared organisation invite email.
  2. Confirm active organisation membership on first load.
  3. Create a client and dog profile.
  4. Open a case and record the presenting complaint.
  5. Capture first session notes and verify save confirmation.

docs.title: Organisation settings
docs.text:
Open Organisation settings to review and maintain core details for your active organisation, including contact and branding-related fields used across the system.

Use Edit settings to update details.

docs.title: Export organisation data
docs.text: Organisation settings includes export actions.

docs.title: Export formats
docs.text:
• JSON
  • CSV ZIP

docs.title: Export flow
docs.text:
1. Choose your export format.
  2. Start export.
  3. Download begins from a time-limited secure link.

docs.title: Export contents
docs.text:
Exports include:

  • Clients
  • Dogs
  • Cases
  • Sessions

If export cannot start, an error message is shown and you can retry.

docs.title: Create a new session
docs.text: From a case page, select New session.

docs.title: Required
docs.text: • Session date/time

docs.title: Common fields available
docs.text:
• Session location
  • Changes since last session
  • New veterinary investigations
  • Guardian concerns
  • Current medication
  • Posture and movement observations
  • Palpation and neurological notes
  • Problem list and clinical impression
  • SMART goals and treatment plan
  • Aftercare and home therapy guidance
  • Follow-up recommended date

docs.title: Session workspace
docs.text: The session editor includes a context rail to keep case/dog/client context visible while writing notes.

docs.title: Save behavior
docs.text: Select Create session to save. If required fields are missing, inline errors are shown before save completes.

docs.title: Vet practices directory
docs.text: Maintain a reusable list of veterinary contacts for referrals and reports.

docs.title: Add a vet practice
docs.text:
From Vet practices:

  1. Select Add vet practice.
  2. Enter Practice name (required).
  3. Optionally add address, email, phone, vet name, and notes.
  4. Select Create vet practice.

docs.title: Use in workflows
docs.text: Assigned vet practices can be linked to dog records and reused in report workflows.

docs.title: Vet reports
docs.text: Use vet reports to generate practitioner-to-vet summaries from session and case data.

docs.title: Open a vet report
docs.text:
1. Open a session.
  2. Select Vet report.

docs.title: Typical report sections
docs.text:
• Past medical history
  • Current medication
  • Intro / letter context
  • Clinical and treatment summary areas

docs.title: Save and export
docs.text:
• Save report changes before sharing.
  • Use print/export actions to produce a shareable output.
  • If PDF generation is unavailable, browser print is used as fallback.
